title: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Heavy Lifting
h1: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Heavy Lifting
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for adjustable dumbbells for heavy lifting, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at adjustable dumbbells for heavy lifting using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PowerBlock Elite EXP Stage 1 Adjustable Dumbbells, 5-50 lb (Pair)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 50 lb per hand, expandable to 90 lb with Stage 2 and 3 kits, Pin-selector weight system, Steel internals for durability under heavy loads.
strengths: Highest achievable ceiling in this list at 90 lb per hand with full expansion
Steel internals hold up well under repeated heavy loading
Staged buying lets you add capacity as your strength grows
limitations: Full 90 lb capacity requires buying both expansion kits on top of the base unit
Pin selector needs deliberate, full seating under heavy loads
features: 5 to 50 lb per hand, expandable to 90 lb with Stage 2 and 3 kits
Steel internals for durability under heavy loads

products.name: Bowflex SelectTech 552 Adjustable Dumbbells (Pair)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments, Dial-turn selector, Largest install base in the category.
strengths: 52.5 lb ceiling covers most intermediate lifters without any expansion purchase
Fastest, most proven mechanism for high-frequency heavy sessions
Widest parts availability if something wears out under heavy use
limitations: No official expansion path once you hit 52.5 lb per hand
Lower total ceiling than a fully expanded PowerBlock
features: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments
Largest install base in the category

products.name: NordicTrack 55 lb Select-a-Weight Dumbbell
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 55 lb per hand, 2.5, 5, and 10 lb increments, iFIT connected workout compatibility.
strengths: Slightly higher fixed ceiling than the Bowflex 552 at 55 lb per hand
iFIT programming includes strength-focused guided sessions
Dial mechanism remains fast even at higher weight settings
limitations: Still well below PowerBlock's expanded 90 lb ceiling
Plastic shell shows more wear than steel-block designs under heavy, frequent use

products.name: Core Home Fitness Adjustable Dumbbell Set & Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 50 lb per hand, TwistLock one-hand cradle adjustment, Stand included.
strengths: 50 lb ceiling is a meaningful step up for lifters progressing past beginner weights
Lower price than the true heavy-lifting picks in this list
TwistLock holds securely once seated for heavier working sets
limitations: Lowest ceiling of the four picks here, will be outgrown sooner by serious lifters
No expansion path once you hit 50 lb per hand

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
